title: Explicit low-degree square-root polynomial for primes congruent to 5 modulo 8

standard_prerequisites.name: Polynomial vanishing sets over finite fields and formal differentiation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author Sections 1-3; original full bibliography retained

core_obligations: Split the quadratic residues into fourth-power residue branches.
Combine the square-root formulas by Chinese remaindering.
Retain the explicit polynomial and author congruence verification.
difficulty_reason: The construction combines the two Tonelli-Shanks residue branches using polynomial Chinese remaindering and exploits cancellation to obtain degree (3p+1)/8; the author also supplies the full congruence calculation. The earlier authorship of this result is retained.
